## Sale Smart

::: {.r-fit-text}

Your task is to produce visualizations in Python that show:
For each city:

 - The average house sale price
 - The average estimated monthly rental income
 - How long it will take a property on average to achieve the sale price from rental income for a selected city.

The visualizations should adhere to User Experience best practices including:

- Inclusive & accessible design
- Appropriate use of visualizations

:::

## The average house sale price



```{python}
#| echo: false
sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Price', showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markerfacecolor':'white', 
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'8'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

## The average house sale price

```{python}
#| echo: false

ss_data = ss_data[ss_data['Price'] < 1800000]
ss_data = ss_data[ss_data['City'] != 'Panorama Heights']

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Price', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

## Visualisation Accessibility 

- no reliance on colour
- appropriate diagram
- acceptable contrast
- alt-text provided


## Estimated monthly rental income

```{python}
#| echo: false

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Rent Estimate', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```


## Time to sale price.


```{python}
#| echo: false

ss_data['Time to even'] = ss_data['Price'] / (ss_data['Rent Estimate'] * 12)

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Time to even', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

## Part 2

:::{.r-fit-text}

We were given some data about Air B&B.

Properites:

```{python}
#| echo: false
prop = pd.read_csv('./Resources/Data/property_info.csv')
rev = pd.read_csv('./Resources/Data/revenue_per_month.csv')
mean_rev = rev.groupby('unified_id')['revenue'].mean().reset_index()
df = pd.merge(prop, mean_rev, on='unified_id')
del prop[prop.columns[0]]
df = df.dropna()
df['bedrooms'] = df['bedrooms'].astype(int)
df['bathrooms'] = df['bathrooms'].astype(int)
di = {'Rd':'Road', 'St':'Street', 'Ave':'Avenue', 'Blvd':'Boulevard', 'Dr':'Drive', 'Ln':'Lane', 'Ct':'Court', 'Pl':'Place', 'Ter':'Terrace', 'Cir':'Circle'}
ss_data['Street Name'].replace(di, regex=True, inplace=True)

combined = pd.merge(df, ss_data, left_on=['street_name','city','bathrooms','bedrooms'], right_on=['Street Name','City','Bathrooms','Bedrooms'], how='inner')


prop.head(2)
```

:::

## Part 2

After:

- finding the average revenue
- combining with the property data
- standardising the road names accross the two data sets
- then matching on city, road, bathrooms and bedrooms

we can compare rental and air B&B revenue


## Rental vs Revenue

:::{.r-fit-text}

```{python}
sub_df = combined[['Rent Estimate','revenue','city']]
r = sub_df[['Rent Estimate','city']]
r['type'] = 'Rent Estimate'
r.rename(columns={'Rent Estimate':'value'}, inplace=True)
#r.head()
l = sub_df[['revenue','city']]
l['type'] = 'Revenue'
l.rename(columns={'revenue':'value'}, inplace=True)
c = pd.concat([l,r], ignore_index=True)
sns.boxplot(data=c, x='city', y='value', hue='type')
```
